Package com.sca4d.core.api.name.code

Class TreeCode

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.name.Name
com.sca4d.core.api.name.code.Code
com.sca4d.core.api.name.code.TreeCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
AppIsolation<Name>, Isolation<Name>, Comparable<Code>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AuthenticationActionCode, GatewayCallbackCode, JobKey, ScheduleKey
public class TreeCode extends Code
为稳定 Code 增加层级追加、连续节点查询和前缀匹配；输出格式不参与层级语义。
